title: Contracting on GAAP Changes: Large Sample Evidence

scopes.description: Complete author-documented GAAP debt-contract workflow, including SEC Exhibit 10 contract/context extraction, Compustat/VIX controls, CIK–GVKEY merging, standard-setter proxies, and the separate manually coded appendix analyses.

requirements.description: Three DirectEdgar tab-delimited candidate-contract exports for 8-K, 10-K and 10-Q filings. The SAS import code parses CIK, report/contract dates and DirectEdgar screen fields (path, source, words, hits, relevance and size), then filters words>7000, hits>15, relevance>0.2 and deduplicates by CIK/contract date/report date. These files are absent from the package.

requirements.description: Four DirectEdgar CSV context exports: two parts for 8-K, one 10-K and one 10-Q. The program stacks them, retains context lines mentioning GAAP/accounting principles, and joins them to the candidate list by CIK, report date and contract date before phrase classification. The CSVs and their schema are absent.

requirements.description: SEC Exhibit 10 contract documents attached to 8-K, 10-K and 10-Q filings. The documented search filters for credit/loan/security agreements and financial covenants with GAAP language; the datasheet says the authors used DirectEdgar in July 2014. The exact filing period, covered exhibits and search/context extraction settings are not fully specified.

routes.description: The SEC provides public filings search, and the datasheet names SEC filings as the source. The page does not establish the exact 2014 population, historical exhibit coverage, query parameters or DirectEdgar context exports.

The exact catalog-listed dataset is readable and contains filing/exhibit metadata fields such as CIK, form, filing date, description and filename. Its probed columns contain no contract body/context text; a one-row probe does not establish coverage and it is not a compatible substitute for DirectEdgar outputs.

The documented raw and parsed SEC exhibit corpus roots are present as directories. Their collection coverage, author-specific filing period and exhibit population, search/query provenance, and DirectEdgar-compatible context extraction have not been checked; no directory discovery or content scan was performed.

requirements.description: Compustat annual fundamentals read from comp.funda using gvkey, datadate, fyear, tic, cik, cusip, indfmt, datafmt, popsrc, consol and accounting/control fields AT, REVT, ACCHG, DD1–DD5, DLTT, SEQ, PRCC_F, CSHO, XRD, IB, PRCH_F and PRCL_F. The authors report a June/July 2014 WRDS extraction. The code has no year restriction before the control construction and winsorization; the exact study period, population, prior-year history and construction compatibility are unresolved; the reported retrieval date is provenance, not a requirement to match a particular vintage.

requirements.description: Daily VIX observations in gaap.vix with date and VIX values. The XPF program sets date_lag=date-120, aggregates VIX by year/month of date_lag, then joins the yearly/monthly aggregates to Compustat controls on datadate year/month. The required raw rows are those whose actual date minus 120 days falls within each joined Compustat month; target months and full source coverage are not specified.

issues.description: Seven DirectEdgar text/CSV inputs are referenced by the SAS program but absent from the package. Step 1 is a block-commented procedure rather than an executable search program. The original filing period, search settings/version, section population and context window needed to reproduce the exports remain unresolved. The documented local raw and parsed exhibit roots exist as candidate locations, but exact sample coverage, query provenance and context compatibility remain unverified.

The remote Compustat query filters format/population but has no year condition; %wins processes q, rnd, roa, levbook, a_growth and uncert across the entire resulting xpf_controls table. a_growth joins the same gvkey’s prior calendar-year datadate. The datasheet reports a June/July 2014 extraction, but required study years, full history, population and construction compatibility remain unknown; a one-row local probe cannot establish coverage.

The import program reads xpf.names with gvkey and cik1 for the contract-to-Compustat join, but no producer or library assignment is supplied. The local COMP.NAMES candidate has CIK and GVKEY columns, but the mapping to the exact xpf.names/cik1 input and historical validity are unverified.

The SAS preparation produces contract classifications, gaap_xpf and a by-year summary, then ends with a comment to convert gaap_xpf through StatTransfer and run Stata regressions. No Stata analysis source or full output program is supplied for the main paper or the appendix’s IA2/IA3 results.

The datasheet identifies FASB minutes and Allen–Ramanna data as separate inputs to standard-setter proxies, but the package contains no minute files, word list, source data, constructions or merge instructions for either proxy.

The file named importing and preparing data.sas is a ZIP/OOXML WordprocessingML container, not plain SAS text. Bounded XML inspection using the frozen paragraph helper recovered 255 SAS-text paragraphs; a plain author-provided .sas file or confirmed extraction procedure is needed before execution. No edits to the container are proposed.

The import program uses [redacted-path-8a2b73a5ef63] context inputs; GAAP and XPF libraries are not assigned in the supplied code. The WRDS remote session configuration, local output locations and required SAS autoexec/library setup are not supplied.

Internet Appendix IA1 uses author-coded practices for 1,410 private credit agreements, while IA2 aggregates main observations by year and IA3 separates UF/FOR results. The raw 3,720-contract author page link does not establish the coded subset, labels or supplemental Stata analyses.

Request DirectEdgar version, filing date range, query syntax, Exhibit 10/form filters, keyword logic, context-window settings, and details behind words/hits/relevance/size fields.

validation: Before a future authorized run, verify all selected Compustat columns, identifier formats, sample years, prior-year observations and the output of the full-input winsor macro against author documentation.

review_notes: Expanded checkpoint after frozen-helper OOXML inspection, same-run packaged/environment probe reuse, frozen catalog lookups, three one-row SAS metadata probes, bounded StatTransfer PATH check and official SEC/WRDS/author landing-page checks. No author code, SAS job, Stata regression, WRDS signon or dataset download was run.

The supplied file importing and preparing data.sas is a ZIP/OOXML WordprocessingML container; the frozen _docx_paragraph_text helper recovers 255 embedded SAS paragraphs while preserving explicit breaks/tabs. XPF variables defined.sas is plain SAS. The container is evidence/code content, not a runnable source path; request the author’s plain .sas file or extraction method.

Producer-consumer order: DirectEdgar SEC contract-list/context exports feed the SAS import and classification steps through GAAP_PANEL. The independent XPF program reads Compustat and VIX inputs and produces XPF controls; it must finish, along with the missing xpf.names map, before importing Step 7 joins by CIK/CIK1 then GVKEY/FYEAR. Step 8 only comments on StatTransfer to Stata; Stata regression code is absent.

Macro/raw-history trace: comp.funda is read remotely with no year restriction. a_growth joins the same gvkey to the prior calendar-year datadate. %wins processes q, rnd, roa, levbook, a_growth and uncert across the full generated xpf_controls table. VIX is read from gaap.vix, shifted by date-120, averaged by shifted year/month and joined to Compustat datadate keys; required source coverage depends on the complete joined months, which are unspecified.

Local COMP.FUNDA and COMP.NAMES probes verify required columns/readability only; WRDSSEC.EXHIBITS is filing/exhibit metadata without body/context columns. The packaged CN 2017_cik_Table1.dta probe shows cik/cdate only, so it is not an analysis-ready dataset and does not support analysis_only.

The complete documented target also includes FASB minutes (1994–2012), Allen–Ramanna proxy inputs and the separate manually coded 1,410-contract appendix sample. The Sufi page’s 3,720 raw-contract link is only a source candidate, not the coded sample. Keep CIK/GVKEY links and SEC filing identities as documented; do not invent substitute sources or undocumented constructions.

Environment probe reports Stata 18 available. SAS failed TKELS initialization and remains unverified rather than absent; StatTransfer was not found under the exact PATH command name, but other installations remain unknown. SAS/CONNECT, WRDS access and DirectEdgar were not verified.
